intent: Fresh original production artwork; reference catalog only, no pixel extraction.

prompts.chef:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a fresh production sprite atlas for a Godot restaurant game, matching the supplied doodle UI/art catalog visually: dimensional rounded chibi forms, broad expressive face, thick clean slightly irregular dark ink outlines, saturated colors, warm highlights and soft shaded volumes, restrained texture. This is an ORIGINAL atlas, not a crop or reconstruction of catalog artwork.
Transparent RGBA background. A precise 4-column by 2-row regular atlas, 1536 by 1024 pixels preferred. Eight equal 384 by 512 cells; no grid lines, captions, labels, UI, numbers, watermark, floor, drop-shadow platform or scenery. Every full-body figure fits its cell, identical scale, centered horizontally, foot base aligned at 90% of each cell height, thin transparent margin. No clipping or overlapping adjacent cells.
Subject: the SAME female starter chef in all eight cells: dark brown skin, kind broad face, curly dark hair tucked under tall rounded white toque, white short-sleeve jacket, rich turquoise apron, navy trousers, brown shoes. Charming compact chunky body about 2.5 heads tall, fully rendered feet. Human hands, simple readable shapes. Slight overhead/front-facing game viewpoint, not isometric.
TOP ROW left-to-right: chef preparing sushi facing screen DOWN/front, chef preparing facing UP/back, chef preparing facing LEFT/profile, chef preparing facing RIGHT/profile. Hands are actively composing a small salmon nigiri at waist height, no workbench, no station, no stool, no blackboard.
BOTTOM ROW left-to-right: the same chef holding exactly one finished white plate with salmon nigiri, facing DOWN/front, UP/back, LEFT/profile, RIGHT/profile. Holding poses show the plate distinct from clothing, waiting patiently.
All eight retain consistent identity, hat proportions, outfit, body scale and camera. Dimensional polished storybook game sprite finish like the catalog's character section, no scratchy etched texture, no flat SVG look, no photorealism. Match one coherent directional animation set.
prompts.customer:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original production character sprite atlas for a Godot restaurant game. Match the supplied doodle UI/art catalog: dimensional rounded chunky chibi sprites, broad simple expressive faces, thick clean dark ink outline, warm gentle highlights and shaded volumes, rich saturated clothing, minimal calm texture. Same visual world as a dark-skinned female chef with white toque and turquoise apron. Do NOT copy or extract source pixels.
A single transparent RGBA 1536x1536 image with EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows of equal 384x384 invisible cells. Sixteen separate full-body sprites. Identical camera and body scale in all cells, centered horizontally with foot base at 90% cell height; full feet visible, no clipping, no overlap, no captions, letters, guides, grids, or text. Each character about 2.5 heads tall. No floor, no chairs, no scenery, no large ground shadows.
ROW 1: CUSTOMER A walking, one relaxed midstep: facing DOWN/front, UP/back, LEFT, RIGHT. A is a cheerful adult woman with warm golden-brown skin, black hair in a high round bun, mustard yellow sweater, teal trousers and dark brown shoes.
ROW 2: same CUSTOMER A seated upright on an INVISIBLE stool, facing DOWN/front, UP/back, LEFT, RIGHT. Thighs approximately horizontal, knees bent and lower legs hang DOWN naturally; no cross-legged/floor-sitting pose. Holding a small white plate with salmon sushi near waist and one hand near mouth for eating, shoulders relaxed. NO stool drawn.
ROW 3: CUSTOMER B walking, one relaxed midstep: DOWN/front, UP/back, LEFT, RIGHT. B is a cheerful adult with fair peach skin, short fluffy vivid red-orange curls, coral red jacket over cream shirt, deep teal trousers and dark brown shoes.
ROW 4: same CUSTOMER B seated upright on an INVISIBLE stool, facing DOWN/front, UP/back, LEFT, RIGHT. Same correct chair-seated posture as row2, thighs horizontal and shins pointing down, full feet, holding a small white plate with salmon nigiri for eating; NO stool drawn.
Read clearly at 60-pixel tall display size. Faces sweet and simple, silhouettes rounded and self-contained. Consistent top/front game camera and light from upper-left across every sprite; no isometric base, no photorealism, no etched noisy texture, no flat vector clipart.
prompts.props:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original game-prop atlas for a polished Godot restaurant game. Match supplied doodle UI/art catalog: thick rounded dark-ink silhouettes, dimensional warm highlights, shaded handpainted storybook volumes, saturated terracotta/wood/teal/leafgreen, restrained grain. Consistent slightly overhead/front-top game viewpoint. These are original isolated production illustrations, never a screenshot or reference crop.
Transparent RGBA background, 1536x1024 preferred, exact 4-column x 2-row uniform atlas with invisible cells and eight separate items. No grid lines, captions, labels, text, numbers, UI, shadows spanning adjacent cells or scenery. Each whole object centered in its cell, with full silhouette and thin clear padding. Full object bottoms align near 90% cell height. No detached stray flourishes. Physical game objects with confident readable outlines and polished shading, not vector clipart.
TOP ROW left to right:
1. Single simple round golden-brown wooden stool with four short stout legs, NO backrest, empty seat. Top is visible elliptical circle, suitable to support an upright seated chibi customer. No cushion or occupant.
2. One salmon nigiri on a small off-white ceramic plate, clearly recognizable bright salmon with three cream diagonal striations over plump rice, plate seen from elevated front-top view. NO garnish, no chopsticks.
3. Small wooden-framed blackboard with dark charcoal blank writing face, short easel legs and chunky amber wood border. Surface blank with NO writing whatsoever, used next to chef. Must read at tiny size.
4. A small terracotta pot with chunky varied shiny green leaves, compact bushy plant.
BOTTOM ROW left to right:
1. A squat warm honeywood barrel with two dark blue metal hoops, subtle wood grain, lid visible.
2. A wooden shipping crate with chunky planks and diagonal brace, warm rusty-brown wood, top visible.
3. A hanging golden-orange harbor lantern with dark metal frame, glowing warm interior, hook above, no attached wall or scenery.
4. A second potted plant with long curving teal-green leaves and a pale cream ceramic pot, visibly different from plant1.
Keep natural materials clean and readable rather than scratched/noisy. Outline weight and light from upper-left consistent across all props. Transparent around every object including between stool legs.
prompts.belt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Fresh empty conveyor-belt module atlas for a Godot sushi restaurant game. Match supplied doodle catalog conveyor section: chunky clean rounded black/brown ink outline, dark blue-charcoal moving belt deck, red-orange lacquer side rails, a few warm brass joint details, brown wooden lower supports. Dimensional handpainted top/front appearance, strong clear silhouette and calm texture, consistently lit from upper-left.
Transparent RGBA sheet, exact 3 columns x 2 rows of equal cells, 1536x1024 pixels preferred. Six independent modules, centered in their invisible square cells with safe clear padding; no grid lines, captions, letters, arrows, UI, sushi, plates, scenery, wood floor or background. All modules have the SAME width/scale and single square-cell footprint. Empty horizontal/vertical straight segments have open flat joining ends designed to butt together continuously; only endpoint modules have one rounded closed bumper. NO T junctions, cross junctions, branching, piles, trays or collection bins. Do not draw a whole complete loop.
Row1 left-to-right:
1. Straight NORTH-SOUTH segment with open flat joining edges at north and south, charcoal deck along vertical center and coral rails at left/right.
2. Straight EAST-WEST segment with open flat joining edges at east and west, charcoal deck along horizontal center and coral rails at top/bottom.
3. NORTH endpoint: open flat connection on south; solid rounded end bumper only at north.
Row2 left-to-right:
1. SOUTH endpoint: open flat connection on north; solid rounded end bumper only at south.
2. WEST endpoint: open flat connection on east; solid rounded end bumper only at west.
3. EAST endpoint: open flat connection on west; solid rounded end bumper only at east.
Viewpoint follows the catalog square top-down grid with front-facing depth only toward screen bottom. Do not rotate the lighting or cast a long ground shadow. Top deck dominates, lower wood support strip stays narrow. Preserve a clean central moving surface where a bright dish will be displayed.
prompts.floor:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production seamless square warm wood floor texture for a Godot doodle restaurant game. One opaque square image, 1024x1024 pixels. Strict orthographic top-down, absolutely no perspective, no frame, no border, no drop shadow, no furniture, no characters, no food, no text, no lighting spotlight or vignette.
A quiet continuous pale honey-maple wood surface formed by very broad horizontal planks, approximately four plank rows across image height, soft clean rounded ink line along joins in muted medium warm brown. Rich but restrained handpainted material treatment matching the doodle catalog: subtle broad grain, very sparse rounded knot swirls, gentle golden highlights, calm tonal variation. Keep it LIGHT and low contrast to support dark outlined characters and colorful sushi above. Avoid orange saturated flooring and dense scratchy lines. Playable square cells will be drawn separately by the game, so do not bake a small square grid into the wood.
Tile perfectly in both horizontal and vertical directions: top edge joins bottom edge, left edge joins right edge with same color and continuous grain; periodic plank pattern, no seam-producing shaded perimeter. Continuous edge-to-edge material, no isolated object. Style is shaded 2D game illustration, not photorealism, not flat vector.
